description: This file defines the ZipOutput class, which manages writing ZIP archive files, including handling entries, writing headers, and finalizing the archive.

classes.name: ZipOutput
classes.description: A class for creating and writing ZIP archive files, managing entries, and finalizing the archive structure.

methods.name: ZipOutput
methods.description: Constructs a ZipOutput object with a filename or File.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the output stream, deleting existing files if necessary.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Adds a ZioEntry to the ZIP archive, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Finalizes the ZIP archive by writing central directory and closing the stream.

methods.name: getFilePointer
methods.description: Returns the current position in the output stream.

methods.name: writeInt
methods.description: Writes a 4-byte integer to the output stream.

methods.name: writeShort
methods.description: Writes a 2-byte short to the output stream.

methods.name: writeString
methods.description: Writes a string as bytes to the output stream.

methods.name: writeBytes
methods.description: Writes a byte array to the output stream.

methods.name: writeBytes (overload)
methods.description: Writes a portion of a byte array to the output stream.
